source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Heater and Air Conditioning, p.1A-50

procedures.title: Air distributor and heater core: replace
steps: Disconnect the battery ground cable and drain the radiator; leave the refrigerant in the system.
Disconnect the heater hoses at the core and plug the core tubes against coolant spills.
Remove the nuts from the distributor studs on the engine side of the firewall.
Remove the right dash pad (Section 1B) and the center instrument cluster (Section 12).
Disconnect the right dash outlet duct from the center duct, then remove the center-duct-to-distributor screws and the center duct.
Remove the distributor-to-firewall screws and pull the distributor back and to the right; once there is room, unhook the bowden cables and wire connectors.
Take the distributor duct out of the car, remove the temperature door camming plate, then remove the core and core housing.
notes: Four-Season system. See figure 62 in the manual (Corvette air distributor and ducts).

procedures.title: Four-Season control head: replace
steps: Remove and install it the same way as the heater control head (see the Heater section).
